# Ethan Noranbrock

[ ![EthanNoranbrock](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/7/75/EthanNoranbrock.jpg/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/268?cb=20261006225716) ](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/7/75/EthanNoranbrock.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20261006225716)

## Ethan Noranbrock

### Tenure

[2025](/wiki/2025)

**Ethan** "**EFORCE**" **Noranbrock** is an American industrial designer who interned at Mattel from June to August 2025 as part of their Innovation and RC teams. Prior to Mattel he interned at Jazwares; he currently is engaged in an internship with Disney Experiences.
